captions.text: Her beauty was a force even the heavens could not command,
a divine radiance that made gods forget their immortality.
The moon envied her glow,
the roses surrendered their fragrance, and
time itself paused to admire her.
She was not merely a queen;
she was the reason even gods learned to bow.

They held on,

And somewhere between friendship and that lingering touch,
two souls became partners,
bound by a destiny neither wished to escape.

Yet,

built upon the unshakable foundation of
friendship.

phases.title: I'm sorry
phases.subtitle: From Heetu, with everything I have

captions.text: The first year passed like a beautiful dream,
until distance began its silent war.
Quarles arose,
misunderstandings darkened their hearts,
and egos clashed where understanding once lived.
The very foundation that had held their love together began
to tremble.
And then,
without warning,
came a mighty wave of conflict,
threatening to drown everything they had once sworn to protect.
